ios.desc:
Ready to master music theory without the boring stuff?
Treble makes learning music fun, interactive, and effective—no matter your experience level.

Whether you're a beginner who wants to understand the basics or a musician looking to sharpen your skills, Treble has you covered with a mix of bite-sized lessons, quizzes, and addictive games designed to help you read, understand, and apply music theory.

Why Treble?
• Engaging Lessons – Learn at your own pace with clear, beginner-friendly explanations.
• Mini Games – Put your skills to the test with fun games that make theory stick.
• Smart Quizzes – Reinforce what you’ve learned and track your progress.
• Read & Explore – Dive deeper into topics like scales, chords, rhythm, and harmony.

Whether you're studying for music exams, composing your own songs, or just curious about how music works—Treble is your go-to theory companion.

Start learning today and unlock the music inside you.

quotes.text:
A buddy and I—both music school grads—were frustrated that most music theory apps were either overly basic, dry, or just not that fun. So we built the one we always wished existed: Treble.

Treble is a mobile app that teaches music theory through interactive lessons, quizzes, and ear training games. Whether you're brushing up on Nashville Numbers, trying to recognize intervals by ear, or diving into chords and harmonic analysis, we designed it to be engaging for beginners and seasoned musicians alike.

Features:

- Bite-sized lessons on scales, rhythm, chords, and more
- Interactive quizzes and mini-games to reinforce learning
- Addictive ear training that actually sticks
- Streak tracking

We just launched on the App Store, and would love feedback from fellow musicians, learners, or curious hackers. It took longer to build than we thought, but we’re proud of where it landed—and have a long roadmap ahead.
